部分 API 网关会依据客户端 TLS 指纹判断请求来源，非浏览器客户端可能在握:
Some API gateways identify clients by TLS fingerprint and may drop non-browser clients during the handshake (usually seen as “Connection reset by peer”). Turning this on switches to curl_cffi's browser TLS stack to raise the success rate for such endpoints.
curl_cffi is optional: when it is not installed this option is greyed out, the plugin falls back to the standard TLS stack and everything else keeps working.
